title: Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

reports.title: Delhi: Man held for circulating obscene AI-generated photos of college acquaintance
Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

summary:
A 22-year-old man named Keshav Bansal was arrested in Delhi for allegedly taking photos of a female college acquaintance from her private social media account and using artificial intelligence to create obscene images and videos. He then shared this content through fake Instagram, Discord, and Facebook accounts, along with several Gmail IDs, to hide his identity. The 22-year-old woman reported the matter to the Cyber Police Station in North Delhi after anonymous accounts told her the morphed material was being circulated.

Police say Bansal, a BTech graduate from East Punjabi Bagh, acted out of personal resentment after repeated insults. Investigators recovered a mobile phone, two SIM cards, and other digital evidence linked to the case. Further investigation is under way.
title_en: Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online
